user.title: Radiator pulse controller
user.description: Select the room/radiator sensors and calibrated Sonoff limits. Leave existing thermostat empty for an independent native thermostat (initially off, 21 °C). An existing thermostat and output helper are optional legacy compatibility inputs. Configuration does not move the valve. Select all legacy valve writers.

data.name: Room name
data.legacy_automations: Legacy control automations that must stay off

tuning.title: Control parameters
tuning.description: Defaults are provisional. Setup remains passive; valve control starts only when you turn on Control enabled. Unchanged fresh sensor reports must be distinguishable from missing data. Control starts disabled again after HA restart or integration reload. Adaptive cooling is experimental and disabled by default; its threshold is fixed for each cooling episode. With a window selected, opening it switches a running pulse to a 15-minute total-open limit without restarting it. There is no initial forced pause. Timed pulse closure starts at least 45 minutes off; repeat only on room demand. Closing the window restores ordinary termination and cooling rules. Room ≤16 °C or radiator ≤10 °C requests immediate window closure while Control enabled is on, including during heating faults. Data/calibration failures use timed recovery: closed window up to 20 minutes on / at least 80 minutes off, open or unknown window up to 15 minutes on / at least 45 minutes off. Only valve-control failures latch a fault. No physical closure or frost protection is guaranteed. On a critical valve-control failure, send one mobile notification per incident and request heat / 20 °C on selected backup climates. Backups stay running until changed manually, including after fault reset.

data.min_rise: Required surface warming before plateau detection (°C)
data.max_sample_gap: Maximum gap within a usable curve (seconds)
data.peak_drop: Cooling needed to confirm a peak (°C)
data.startup_excess: Maximum surface excess for starting after restart (°C)
data.reporting_verified: I verified that fresh temperature reports arrive even at constant temperature
data.cooling_fraction_max: Maximum remaining temperature excess with adaptive cooling (fraction)
data.cooling_full_error: Projected room deficit for maximum restart fraction (°C)
data.cooling_min_gap: Minimum gap below closing threshold for adaptive increase (°C)
data.window_cover: Window motor (optional; enables 25% PWM and emergency closure)

error.distinct_entities: Select separate entities for each role.
error.entity_unavailable: A selected entity is missing or unavailable.
error.invalid_temperature: A sensor does not report a finite temperature.
error.celsius_required: Both sensors must report degrees Celsius.
error.unsupported_climate: Both thermostats must support heat and off.
error.unsupported_limits: Limit entities must support the full 0–100 range.
error.inverted_limits: The minimum position (100 minus closing limit) must not exceed the opening limit.
error.invalid_settings: Check positive values, fractions between 0 and 1, hysteresis, delay bounds, sample gap and maximum heating duration.
error.unsupported_window: The window cover must support closing.
error.backup_is_primary: A backup must not be the primary room thermostat or radiator valve.
error.unsupported_backup: Each backup must support heating with a 20 °C target.
error.optimistic_valve_limits: Valve limit entities must provide confirmed feedback rather than optimistic state.
